# fixture: invoice-extraction  target: chat  card: 2026-11-13.1  ok: true

## field: prompt
You are a meticulous bookkeeping assistant.
Extract invoice fields from pasted invoice text so I can load them into my bookkeeping sheet.

Invoice text (source data):
"""
ACME Supplies Ltd
Invoice #A-1042  Date: 03/11/2026
Bill to: Riverbend Cafe
2 x Espresso grinder burr set @ 45.00
Subtotal 90.00  VAT 20% 18.00  Total GBP 108.00
Due in 30 days
"""

Format: json
Return only JSON that validates against this JSON Schema:
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "vendor",
    "invoice_number",
    "invoice_date",
    "currency",
    "total"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "vendor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "invoice_number": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "invoice_date": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "format": "date"
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "total": {
      "type": [
        "number",
        "null"
      ]
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}

Rules:
- Use null for any field that is not present; never guess
- Dates as ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD)

Examples:
- Invoice 77 from Bolt Co, 1 Jan 2026, total $50 -> {"vendor":"Bolt Co","invoice_number":"77","invoice_date":"2026-01-01","currency":"USD","total":50} (currency inferred from the $ sign)

Assumptions (say so first if one is wrong for the task):
- Dates are day/month/year (UK vendor)
